evaluation.promotion: No Phase0 promotion or System1.5 integration
evaluation.resampling_unit: canonical paired_world; same draws across compared lanes

fabrics.encoder: full-context row-state + existing final-layer entity-local graft

loss.action_reduction: mean CE over canonical eligible ACT endpoints
loss.contrast_reduction: mean eligible directed support-pair hinge; no canonical eligible pairs in this phase
loss.renderer_reduction: mean pair squared semantic norm + aligned candidate squared norm averaged over candidates
loss.supervised_reduction: sum available coordinates/candidates per row, mean over eligible rows

population: First rows in file order; paired renderings grouped by paired_world.

training.aggregation: Shared five-term weighted objective; unavailable supervision masked
training.normalization: TRAIN-only mean/std embedded in graft checkpoint
